scenes.setting: Beside the grave pit: torn tarot cards in the soil and a spiritual intuition that this really is Will Auceptin — how does a child tied to the Snake of Mercury simply die? The tomb keeper is sent running for the police, and prayer steadies the shaken doctor
scenes.text_anchor: “There’s nothing to be afraid of. He’s already dead.”

scenes.setting: The police station: disbelief turns to swift release once someone steps out of the room — the Nighthawks at work, the gray-windbreaker captain passing him without a flicker; in the carriage, the case looks closed. 'It's the fate of every private detective.'
scenes.text_anchor: “It’s the fate of every private detective.”

scenes.setting: Grimm Cemetery in mourning black: the 400-pound loan from Glaint settled (a night at Mr. A's gathering as escort), greenhouse flowers laid on Mrs. Aulisa's grave in thanks for the characteristic she left — and Lawrence appears with flowers of his own, then collapses coughing. 'My life might be coming to an end…'
scenes.text_anchor: “My life might be coming to an end…”
